{{Quote|Solo, I '''trust''' you about as much as I'd trust riding a '''spice-keg''' through a '''meteor swarm'''-- but you've intrigued me enough to give you a '''reprieve'''... and a '''free meal'''.|Crimson Jack|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 11">[[Star Wars (1977) 11|''Star Wars'' (1977) 11]]</ref>}}
A '''spice-keg''' is a keg that contains [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. [[Crimson Jack/Legends|Crimson Jack]] claimed to trust [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] as much as he'd trust riding a spice-keg through a meteor swarm.
